phase: Phase 4 — Reliable AI generation and history UX
currentTask: Close remaining media-cache lifecycle gaps and keep startup photo/timeline restoration consistent.
lastKnownBlocker: ComfyUI downloads were written under cache/generation but that path was not exposed by FileProvider, which could fail at runtime when creating the generated scene URI.
fixApplied: FileProvider now exposes cache/generation, persisted ComfyUI downloads are deleted immediately, cancelled full-regeneration downloads are cleaned safely, pending MediaStore saves expire automatically, late Media3 callbacks are ignored after cancel, and startup context no longer pairs a loose photo with an older timeline key.
next: Continue auditing private/cache media lifecycle for process interruption edge cases
Keep atomic full-regeneration and deterministic ComfyUI output guarantees intact
